A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DareU research work. All 23 pages, including figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–G, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original unlearning experiments on TOFU and ArXiv with Llama2-7B and Qwen3-8B, including benchmark results in Tables 2–3 and additional appendix experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results in Tables 2–3 and the empirical analyses in the appendices.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same attribution classifier, PPO procedure, reward computation, and distillation regularization.

E1.justification: Both versions use TOFU question answering and ArXiv text completion. The sequential-unlearning, semantic-overlap, paraphrased-query, and other appendix scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator participation is unchanged across corresponding experiments, including Retraining, Fine-tune, GA, GDiff, SCRUB, SCRN, IDK, and NPO. Attribution-function comparisons also remain identical.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendices E–F retain the same models, dataset partitions, sample counts, metrics, training budgets, and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The attribution analyses and Appendix F experiments are unchanged, including reward ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity, scalability, sequential unlearning, classifier inaccuracies, semantic overlaps, adversarial probing, relearning, and generation collapse.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging over seeds 41, 42, and 43 in Appendix E and retain identical uncertainty reporting. Table 8 still explicitly reports only seed 42 for full-parameter unlearning.

E6.justification: Tables 1–20 and Figures 1–8 retain the same numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative examples. No result entries or scientific findings are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation in Sections 3–4, PPO derivation and assumptions in Appendix D, and computational-complexity expressions in Appendix G are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about data de-attribution, the DareU framework, and balancing forget quality with model utility.

C2.justification: Scientific interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including computational costs, imperfect attribution, required training-data access, and the qualification that de-attribution does not certify unlearning.

D1.justification: Implementation details, model-access references, LoRA settings, training hyperparameters, and the NVIDIA H200 hardware disclosure in Appendix E are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A, and the cited works are unchanged. The bibliography only reflows; the newly acknowledged individuals do not constitute new citations or research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds a sentence thanking Gregory Kang Ruey Lau and Xinyuan Niu for suggestions and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded acknowledgments move from page 9 to page 10, reflowing the references across pages 10–12. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds contributor acknowledgments and makes minor layout and version-stamp updates. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information, including all appendices, are unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
